description: Assume the project failed a year from now and explain why.
output_pattern: Failure causes then likelihood then prevention

description: Attack the plan as an adversary or a competitor would.
output_pattern: Attack paths then impact then countermeasure

description: List how each part can fail and what the failure causes.
output_pattern: Part then failure then effect then mitigation

description: Probe the boundaries: empty and huge and concurrent and offline and malicious input.
output_pattern: Case then expected behaviour then gap

description: List every assumption and rate it by how much depends on it and how sure we are.
output_pattern: Assumption then evidence then test

description: Argue the strongest case against the current direction.
output_pattern: Objection then reply then residual risk

description: Decide what result would prove the idea wrong and how to look for it.
output_pattern: Claim then disproof then cheapest test

description: Strip the problem to facts that are certainly true and rebuild the solution from them.
output_pattern: Fact then inference then new option

description: Ask why until you reach a cause that can be changed.
output_pattern: Symptom then why chain then root cause

description: Ask what would guarantee failure and avoid it.
output_pattern: Guarantee of failure then avoidance

description: Follow each consequence one step further.
output_pattern: Change then first effect then second effect

description: List who is affected or has power and what each one wants and fears.
output_pattern: Stakeholder then interest then influence then plan

description: Walk the draft as each user type and note where they stumble.
output_pattern: Persona then step then friction then fix

description: State the job the user hires the solution for and test the draft against it.
output_pattern: Job then current solution then gap

description: Test each requirement for clarity and testability and independence.
output_pattern: Requirement then problem then rewrite

description: Find words that two readers would interpret differently and define them.
output_pattern: Term then readings then definition

description: Compare sections for contradictions and missing links.
output_pattern: Statement A then statement B then resolution

description: Estimate the cost and the benefit of each item and drop the weak ones.
output_pattern: Item then cost then benefit then verdict

description: Name what is not done because of this choice.
output_pattern: Choice then alternative then trade-off

description: Find the smallest version that still delivers the core value.
output_pattern: Feature then essential or not then cut
